description: fluxedUp inpaint of an uploaded photo; most photo-real result, but hit or miss per seed

seed.note: seed matters a lot: seed 1 left the area empty, seed 2 drew a very good cat

sampler.note: euler/simple 28 steps + guidance 10 drew nothing in the one test

width.note: photo size, used for the Flux shift only

faceVariety.note: SameFace Fix LoRA (Civitai 766608, VadimFedenko) at a NEGATIVE weight: trained on the typical Flux faces of women, so it pushes the model away from them; the page shows 0..2.5, factor -1 makes the weight; 0 = the model as it was. On fluxedUp the author's -0.6..-0.9 barely change the face; 2026-10-27 test (same seeds): -1.5 starts to change it, -2.0 gives other people without artefacts
